grh_67f1a66bec1e434f33bb.title: Leiningen Versus the Ants -Tudor Owen

grh_675a599546e69d654e9e.title: When My Baby Smiles at Me
paragraphs: Burlesque partners Skid Johnson and Bonnie Kane marry and build an act together, but Skid's Broadway success, drinking and involvement with dancer Sylvia Marco pull him away from Bonnie and eventually break up their partnership. Bonnie tries to move on while Skid's career and health collapse under alcohol, leaving him barely able to perform. When she finds him failing backstage, Bonnie returns to the act, holds him up through the number and reveals that she never married the wealthy rancher who courted her because she still loves Skid; the pair reunite onstage and off.

This version presents a radio version of [[work|work.sdp.film.63ce9bedb029f6ae|When My Baby Smiles at Me]]. Milton Geiger adapted it for radio.

grh_678a11730f573228b8f0.title: In Flanders Field
paragraphs: During a First World War entertainment behind the lines, Holmes investigates a disappearance and a shot fired with a German pistol. He proves that General Morley's own brother Maitland has been spying for the enemy and attempted to kill Holmes before crossing to the German lines. Holmes arranges for Maitland to carry identifying evidence that makes the Germans believe they have captured Sherlock Holmes, turning the traitor's escape against him while preserving the coming Allied operation.

grh_673a0f8484e9a4b99bba.title: Costellos Horse Peanut Butter
paragraphs: Lou buys a horse named Peanut Butter and insists on entering the animal in a race, while Abbott and young Sebastian try to explain bridles, bits, reins and training.
